short: Same three parts and same Table 1 values as MiSTR (2025, same first two authors), not cited. Features (M06) and phase vocoder (M08) standard, unablated; no listener test (M12, behind).
position: The chapter [@alradhi2026brain] changes the neural features (M06) and the waveform step (M08); both are standard and unablated. MiSTR [@alradhi2025mistr], by the same first two authors, lists the same three parts and reports the same 28 Table 1 values; the chapter's reference list does not include it. The evaluation (M12) is behind: no listener test, against 24 prior listener-test studies (Appendix) and naturalness of 18–29 of 100 on the same dataset [@arthur2024speech]. The claim of highly intelligible speech has no listener measure, Table 1 contradicts the uniformly lower MCD, and two baseline MCDs come from [@arthur2024speech]'s 80/20 split rather than the stated shared protocol.
